notes.title: Machinefall Demo Update: Enter the Stone Age!
notes.notes:
Survivors, the wasteland just got a whole lot more primal!

New release of Machinefall’s Demo update, introducing an all-new Stone Age Technology Era is out!

This update adds a gritty new layer of survival and strategy, where every stone and spark matters. Whether you’re carving out a new tribe or reforging your empire from the rubble, the Stone Age offers new ways to adapt, fight, and thrive in the ruins of Machinefall.

The update is live now — sharpen your stones and step into humanity’s fight for survival.
